turbulence.note: ATMOSPHERIC values copied from the MATLAB reference script. To be replaced with measured underwater (Baltic) values.

designDefaults._note: Used when a vehicle profile leaves a planform field empty (older profiles, imports).

lateral._note: Roll inertia estimate I_x = m0*(D^2/8 + (Rx*b/2)^2), yaw I_z = I_y + m0*(Rx*b/2)^2, b = wing (front pair) span. Rx = non-dimensional radius of gyration 2k_x/b (~0.25 light aircraft, Roskam).

verticalTail._note: Effective aspect ratio of a single vertical fin = factor x geometric AR (h^2/S): endplate effect of fuselage and tailplane (Raymer, Aircraft Design, ~1.55 for conventional tails).

delta._note: Polhamus leading-edge-suction analogy (NASA TN D-3767, 1966). Kv = vortex-lift factor: pi is the slender-wing limit; Polhamus' chart gives roughly 3-3.4 for AR 0.5-2.5 – check against the chart for your AR. stallAlphaDeg: vortex breakdown reaches the trailing edge; Polhamus overpredicts lift beyond it. 25 deg gives CLmax ~1.3-1.4 for a 60 deg delta, in line with test data.

atmosphere._note: ISA 0-20 km. Envelope chart: altitude grid 0..envelopeMaxAltitude_m in envelopeAltitudeSteps, speed grid over the cruise-speed span in envelopeSpeedSteps.

engine._note: Available power = P_max * (rho/rho0)^powerLapseExponent with ISA altitude. ~0.7 turbine-like; 1 = proportional to density; 0 = no lapse.

compressibility._note: Korn equation kappa_A: 0.87 conventional sections, 0.95 supercritical (per section in sections.json as kornKappa). idealSectionThickness = t/c assumed for the ideal 2-pi section.
